root.title: POTATO OF LIFE
root.summary: Canonical root map for the living Potato of Life archive. Public navigation follows relationships between Tim, Son, Spirit, transformation, cosmology, science, body, traditions, North, world, chronology, works and sources; substantive claims remain owned by canonical records.

principles: manifest points to canonical owners rather than duplicating their contents
historical strata are archived rather than silently erased
project canon, documentary evidence, comparison and empirical claims remain distinguishable
make everything accessible; make nothing falsely certain
recover conversation history as source material, then deduplicate and classify before promotion
scientific analogies must be separated from established physics and from original Tim equations
unrecovered primary equations are recovery targets, never reconstructed as if verbatim
contextual synchronisms enrich interpretation but do not prove causation, prophecy or sovereignty
prophecy claims are graded by prior wording, specificity, chronology and independent match
